_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture for pa_agent.data.okx_source. okx.com is unreachable from the review machine (HTTP 000), so this payload was written from the documented /api/v5/market/candles schema ([ts, o, h, l, c, vol, volCcy, volCcyQuote, confirm], newest first, confirm='0' while forming) cross-checked against three public OKX clients. It is NOT a recorded live response. Rows are SPOT BTC-USDT 15m: vol = base (BTC), volCcy = quote (USDT), volCcyQuote = quote (USDT).
